title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find answers to common questions about marbot.app. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us directly.

what.question: What is marbot.app?
what.answer: marbot.app is a free mosque management platform designed specifically for Indonesian mosque administrators. It helps you manage congregation data, finances, ZISWAF, events, and more — all in one place, completely free.

free.question: Is marbot.app really free?
free.answer: Yes, marbot.app is 100% free for individual mosques. There are no hidden fees, no premium tiers, and no time limits. All 12 modules and core features are available at no cost, forever. We also offer a Pro plan with advanced features and a Sponsored plan for organizations managing multiple mosques.

dataSafety.question: Is my mosque data safe?
dataSafety.answer: Absolutely. Each mosque has its own separate database — your data is never mixed with other mosques. We use industry-standard encryption and security practices to protect your information. Regular backups ensure your data is always safe and recoverable.

offline.question: Can I use marbot.app offline?
offline.answer: marbot.app is a web-based application that requires an internet connection. However, you can export all your data to PDF or CSV at any time for offline access. We recommend using the app online for the best experience with real-time updates and automatic backups.

whoCanRegister.question: Who can register a mosque on marbot.app?
whoCanRegister.answer: Any mosque administrator can register — DKM chairman, treasurer, secretary, marbot, or any authorized person. During registration, you'll provide the mosque name and location. Only authorized administrators should manage the mosque account to ensure data integrity.

dataImport.question: Can I import existing data into marbot.app?
dataImport.answer: Yes. You can import congregation data from CSV or Excel files. This makes it easy to migrate from spreadsheets or other record-keeping systems. Our import tool maps your existing columns to the right fields in marbot.app.

psak109.question: Does marbot.app comply with PSAK 109?
psak109.answer: Yes. The ZISWAF & Zakat module is fully compliant with PSAK 109 (Statement of Financial Accounting Standards for Zakat, Infaq, and Sadaqah). Financial reports generated by marbot.app follow the required format, so you can present them directly to auditors or congregation meetings.

multipleMosques.question: Can I manage more than one mosque?
multipleMosques.answer: Yes. Each mosque is set up as a separate account with its own data. If you manage multiple mosques, you can register each one individually. For organizations managing many mosques, our Sponsored plan provides a centralized dashboard to oversee all of them from one place.
